text:
Problem 1


Code
data <- read.csv("http://manctsui.github.io/datasets/timesData.csv")
reactable(data, defaultPageSize = 5, searchable = T)








Problem 2


Code
UCLA_rankings <- data |>
  filter(grepl("Los Angeles", university_name)) |>
  arrange(year)

reactable(UCLA_rankings)








Problem 3 & 4

Code
UCLA_rankings$world_rank <- as.numeric(UCLA_rankings$world_rank)

ggplot(UCLA_rankings, aes(x = year, y = world_rank)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "UCLA World Rank by Year", x = "Year", y = "World Rank") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(7, 16)) +
  scale_y_reverse()
UCBERK_rankings <- data |>
  filter(grepl("Berkeley", university_name)) |>
  arrange(year)

UCBERK_rankings$world_rank <- as.numeric(UCBERK_rankings$world_rank)

ggplot(UCBERK_rankings, aes(x = year, y = world_rank)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "UC Berkeley World Rank by Year", x = "Year", y = "World Rank") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(7, 16)) +
  scale_y_reverse()



















Figure 1





Problem 5


Code
top_50_universities <- data |>
  filter(world_rank >= 50)

count_us_top_universities_year <- top_50_universities |>
  group_by(country, year) |>
  summarise(num_top_universities = n_distinct(university_name), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(grepl("United States of America", country))

ggplot(count_us_top_universities_year, aes(x = year, y = num_top_universities)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Number of Top 50 Ranked American Universities by Year", x = "Year", y = "Number of Universities")
